idea-plugin.name: Markit Editor
idea-plugin.description:
A Typora-style live preview Markdown editor for IntelliJ IDEA focused on comfortable, long-form reading and writing. Opens as a dedicated tab alongside the default editor: the whole document is rendered, and the markdown syntax of the element under the caret is revealed for editing.
Key Features: - Live Preview Editing: headings, emphasis, links, lists, task lists, quotes, code blocks, images and tables render in place; click into an element to edit its markdown. - Reading-Optimised Typography: NV Palatium for body text and Geist Mono (by Vercel) for code. - Seamless Sync: Bi-directional synchronization with the standard IntelliJ editor. - Theme Awareness: Automatically adapts to Light and Dark IDE themes.
